zh: 一个字符是否只出现一次取决于它在整个字符串中的出现次数，必须先看完全串才能判断。
扫描两遍：第一遍统计 26 个字母的频次，第二遍从左到右找第一个频次为 1 的字符。
用 26 个计数器统计频次；再按下标顺序检查，遇到频次为 1 的位置立即输出它的 1 基下标（下标加 1）；一个都没有则输出 −1。
en: Whether a character appears only once depends on its count in the whole string, so you must see the entire string before deciding.
Make two passes: the first counts the 26 letters, the second goes left to right looking for the first character whose count is 1.
Count with 26 counters; then check positions in order and print the 1-based index (index plus 1) of the first character whose count is 1; if there is none, print −1.

explanationEn:
## Approach

First count the frequencies of the 26 letters, then scan from left to right for the first position whose frequency is 1.

## Proof of correctness

The count gives each character's exact number of occurrences in the whole string, and a frequency of 1 is exactly equivalent to being unique. The second pass goes in increasing position order, so the first position that qualifies is the earliest unique character; if none is found after the full pass, there is no answer.

## Complexity

O(n) time and O(26) extra space.
